freeze_policy: Read actual model YAML backbone modules; exclude frozen tensors from optimizer; reset backbone eval before each forward; hash parameters AND buffers before/after training
fixed_projection_policy: Keep Ultralytics DFL projection fixed for every strategy

replay.definition: 20% D-Fire image presentations in mixed epoch
replay.repetition_policy: Fixed seeded selection per run; each image once per epoch
replay.parameter_policy: Same backbone freeze and buffer preservation as Strategy B

evaluation.temporal_config_policy: Keep historical provisional config fixed for checkpoint-only comparison; any retuning requires a new validation-only protocol
evaluation.test_policy: No test metrics before validation selection and verified independence; never train on reserved test candidates

resource_gate: Require valid data plus a timed pilot and explicit bounded runtime before training. No estimate available for the current blocked corpus.
provenance_gate: Require reviewed bbox/image/label/source hashes, source-PTS lineage, locked grouped splits and resolved leakage candidates. Legacy reviewed=True and event GT are insufficient.
revision_reason: User requirement: Strategy C is frozen backbone plus 20 percent D-Fire replay, not full finetuning plus replay
